objective: Measure representation changes when identical story facts arrive in different orders.
context: Paired story paths with identical sentence multisets and final endpoint, English/Chinese semantic drafts, family-level splits, cumulative prefix activations, separate blinded human ratings and reliability gate.

steps.name: Construct reveal paths
steps.description: Preserve facts and endpoint while changing the reveal order.

steps.name: Freeze families
steps.description: Keep all paired paths and translations in one split.

steps.name: Capture activations
steps.description: Specify model revision, prefix position and robustness readout.

steps.name: Obtain ratings
steps.description: Use blinded prefix-only annotators and reliability gate.

steps.name: Estimate path effect
steps.description: Separate reveal jumps, endpoint hysteresis and cross-language geometry.

steps.name: Qualify evidence
steps.description: Distinguish lexical controls from narrative-order and recency effects.

specific_questions.prompt: Define a paired endpoint hysteresis statistic and a revelation-jump statistic using a toy trajectory.
Explain why matching sentence multisets does not remove order or recency effects.
Describe how annotation reliability and source-family separation constrain semantic conclusions.

native_verifier: GPTStoryworld moral_hysteresis_v1 validation and activation analysis; human ratings and semantics separate.
